_comment: Stealth vs offense changes how the world reacts to Miro, never the plot. MISSING = stealth, HUNTED = offense (>= 3 committed kills, or offense points above stealth points). Level 1 is neutral. See docs/STORY_AND_SYSTEMS_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

MISSING.pa: Prisoner M-07 unaccounted for. Search your sections.
MISSING.thought: If nobody sees me, I'm only a rumour.
MISSING.remote_call: Nobody even knows your face anymore. Come home before they do.
guard_line: Someone let him out. Somebody on our shift.
Check the lockers again. He can't just vanish.
MISSING.boss_prefight: You walked through my whole tower and nobody saw you. You could have just left.
MISSING.ending_thought: They'll never know who did it. Maybe that's what freedom is.

HUNTED.pa: Prisoner M-07 is armed and has killed Keepers. Lethal force authorised.
HUNTED.thought: Maybe they were right about me.
HUNTED.remote_call: They're calling you a monster. Stop proving them right.
guard_line: He killed Rowan. Rowan had a daughter.
Stay in pairs. Don't let him get close.
HUNTED.boss_prefight: How many, Miro? How many before you're what they said?
HUNTED.ending_pa: Prisoner M-07 is the bomber. All units...
HUNTED.ending_thought: They'll tell it their way. Let them.
HUNTED.report: The tower thinks you're hunting them.

kill_disappointment: I can hear the alarms from here. Please stop.
